editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Exness is a legitimate broker with FCA and CySEC licences — but those licences only protect UK and EU clients respectively. The vast majority of global retail traders (India, Southeast Asia, MENA, Africa) are served by Exness (SC) Ltd under FSA Seychelles with no investor compensation and no external dispute resolution. Withdrawal speed is genuinely exceptional and independently confirmed. Spreads on Raw Spread and Zero accounts are competitive. The unlimited leverage marketing is irresponsible for undercapitalised accounts. NAFT rates Exness 7.5/10 in January 2026 — a capable broker for experienced traders who understand exactly which entity holds their funds.
